skeptic.argument: Third re-check of the four must-findings. f-0001 and f-0002 are confirmed by README.md still not existing; f-0006 by lib/session.js:369 and the concurrency group; f-0017 by grepping lib/ for session.mode. Nothing here is unsupported. No deletions, and I would say so if there were.

builder.argument: Every recommendation on the board now names a file and a change. I have nothing left to sharpen without rewriting for its own sake.

dreamer.argument: Two passes without a new frame. The gap-hunting enumerators — a dimension no finding mentions, an audience nobody wrote for, a document that should exist and does not — all come back empty against this inventory. That is a survey result, not silence.

empath.argument: One thing left. f-0013 says the test count in prose goes stale, ranked 'could'. It costs a reader nothing — a wrong count in a README sentence misleads no one about behaviour — and it is sitting above nothing. It is a note, and calling it a finding inflates the apparent size of the problem.
